title: Decide how much authority the candidate has earned
description: Compare candidate evidence, choose a rollout mode, and adjust exposure. Promotion depends on quality, guardrails, uncertainty, and reversibility together.

candidates.label: Balanced candidate
candidates.detail: Improves the primary metric without a measured guardrail regression.

candidates.label: Fast but uneven candidate
candidates.detail: Raises aggregate quality, but one critical slice regresses.

candidates.label: Accurate but slow candidate
candidates.detail: Wins offline quality while consuming too much of the serving latency budget.

rolloutModes.label: Shadow
rolloutModes.detail: Observe production inputs without changing user outcomes.

rolloutModes.label: Canary
rolloutModes.detail: Give the candidate limited authority with automatic rollback.

rolloutModes.label: Randomized experiment
rolloutModes.detail: Measure causal outcome differences on comparable cohorts.

rolloutModes.label: Full rollout
rolloutModes.detail: Serve all eligible traffic; rollback is still possible but blast radius is highest.
